BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all the current RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 8-H in the area bounded by:

a line 192.06 north of and parallel to West Pershing Road; South Hermitage Avenue; a line
167.06 north of and parallel to West Pershing Road; and the public alley next west of and
parallel to South Hermitage Avenue

to those of a RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Common Property Address: 3842 South Hermitage Avenue
